prompt:
Same art style as the reference frames, which are the locked seed: sumi-e ink wash on warm paper, flat fills, palette limited to paper-cream, mist-pale, wash greys and ink-black. Third-person follow view from slightly above and behind a small traveller in a straw hat. COMPOSITION (STYLE-BIBLE section 5, mandatory): a dark near-vertical cliff mass fills the LEFT side of the frame with vertical fracture lines; a bright cloud-sea void fills the RIGHT side; the walkable path is the narrow lighter ledge on the seam between them, with a defined dark edge where it meets the void. Horizon high, void fills the lower-right. Cliff tops flat, faces near-vertical, no rounded rock. Torii are vermilion post-and-lintel gates placed in sequence along the path as waypoints; vermilion appears on the torii and nowhere else. Crows are ink-black, never coloured. No floating platforms: every ledge is attached to the cliff. No text, no UI, no light source, no cast shadows.

Segment 3. A long level ledge on the seam. Partway along it a heavy dark stone slab slides out of the cliff face, straight across the path and over the edge into the void, then back into the cliff, like a piston. Just before the slab, a single black crow is perched on a knob of the cliff face, clearly visible against the pale wall above the path. The traveller stands at a vermilion torii, waiting. A second vermilion torii stands on the ledge beyond the slab.
